title: Review of c40's CIPS layered-divide claim on fresh seeds 5 and 6 with the fuel fork on seed 5: bodies from a random field divide by pinching (11/13 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges), carry an s rim (labkit radial rim/core 4.7-4.9, 69-71 of 77 individuals) and all 16 dissolve within 100 t when fuel regrowth stops while the fed twin grows to 18; Supported for S, I, B, E, D
summary: I ran the claim's world.py unchanged with labkit (200 frames, t=20000) on seeds 5 and 6, and the claim's fork.py on seed 5 from the shared state at t=12000 (controls/; fed twin vs kF=0 vs kF=0 with turnover d=0, 1000 t after). From a smoothed random field (sheet t=0) enzyme condensates nucleate by t~800 and divide by dumbbell pinching into round daughters (rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=2700-3500, 12100, 18300): persistent splits 11 and 13, max generation 3 and 3, 0 merges, 17 bodies at the end on both seeds. labkit radial s: rim/core 4.71 and 4.85, rim/out 20.2 and 20.1, membrane-like in 71/77 and 69/77 individuals, and s is the only membrane-like channel for the top tracks at mid-life. Fork (controls/fork_s5_counts.json): fed twin 16 -> 18 bodies by t=13000 (two divisions), kF=0: 16 -> 8 bodies at +50 t -> 0, and the same with turnover off; the enzyme field returns to the bath (max e 0.12). The enzyme is made uniformly and is not built from the fuel; the bodies dissolve because condensation needs the catalytic flux, so I do not mark E by construction. B: s is made only by catalysis and placed by a drift up grad 4e(1-e); I did not recompute the share of s the bodies make (the claim reports 49-53% at t=1000 and 77-83% at t=8900).

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: smooth random field over the whole box, no bodies
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=800-20000: 6 then 17 discrete round/rod bodies of fixed width
observations.B: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md radial s rim/core 4.71, rim/out 20.2, 71/77 individuals membrane-like; seed 6: 4.85, 20.1, 69/77
observations.E: controls/fork_s5_counts.json and fork_s5.png: kF=0 at t=12000 dissolves all 16 bodies within 100 t (with or without turnover) while the fed twin goes 16 -> 18
observations.D: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 11 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; seed 6: 13, generation 3, 0 merges

seeds_run.result: pass: S, I, B, D; E fork passes

controls_run.E: controls/fork_s5_counts.json, controls/fork_s5.png (claim's fork.py on my seed 5: fed vs kF=0 vs kF=0,d=0)

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds and one fork seed at the claim's settings; no dt/2, grid or chi_s=0 re-run. The fork removes fuel regrowth everywhere at once; a local cut on one body (c40's local-cut findings) is the stronger per-individual test. The s layer's source share was not recomputed, and s acts back on nothing, so the layer does no work in this world.
